scope: deploy/owned_daemon.py registration and whole-parent shutdown authority

findings.requirement: Whole-parent shutdown must control only a freshly provisioned isolated worker parent.
findings.observed: Registration accepts any owner-writable domain whose basename matches an arbitrary .slice name; fresh data-root provisioning does not bind worker-parent creation or exclude staging worker domains. Shutdown always kills the entire registered worker parent.
findings.correction: Require dedicated worker namespace and explicit fresh kernel-parent provisioning receipt, exact native identity and protected-domain disjointness before publishing a controllable manifest. Enforce daemon/operator/worker disjointness during registration rather than relying on a later caller verification.

positive_observations: Fresh daemon data and execution directories reject existing roots and protected infrastructure overlaps.
Shutdown retains exact epoch and kernel identity failures; it does not replace a positive barrier with empty container inventory.
